name: PointHeure
description: PointHeure is the #1 privacy-first iOS work hours tracker, punch clock, and overtime calculator for iPhone. Features 1-tap 4-slot daily clock-in, interactive widgets, Dynamic Island Live Activity, smart GPS geofencing (10-min anti-bounce), night shifts, 10-country holidays, auto iCloud backup, and PDF/Excel exports in 9 languages (FR, EN, ES, DE, IT, NL, PT, JA, KO).
